---
title: "Hypothesis status board"
---

```{r}
root <- ".."
source(file.path(root, "R", "status.R"))
board <- hypothesis_board(file.path(root, "hypotheses"))
lock  <- yaml::read_yaml(file.path(root, "config", "upstream.lock.yml"))
```

Built against MOSAiC commit `r substr(lock$mosaic_commit, 1, 7)`; upstream lock last updated `r lock$lock_updated`.
Rules for adding a hypothesis are in [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/urol-e5/MOSAiC-hypotheses/blob/main/CLAUDE.md).

::: {.callout-warning}
## Read verdicts with their caveats

Statuses record the pre-registered decision rule. They do not establish every
part of a hypothesis's title. Each completed analysis links to its full result,
sample sizes, effect estimates, and caveats below.

Unresolved [data QC findings](qc.qmd#unresolved-interpretation-limits), including
the calcification scale shift and mixed taxonomy in the broader cohort, limit
biological interpretation even when integrity checks pass.
The [2026-10-12 follow-up](qc-follow-up.qmd) confirms inconsistent calcification
time units and reports H10's intended-host-annotation sensitivity.
:::

```{r}
library(gt)
status_colors <- c(proposed = "#f8f9fa", planned = "#e9ecef", running = "#fff3cd", supported = "#d1e7dd",
                   `not supported` = "#f8d7da", inconclusive = "#e2e3e5", withdrawn = "#dee2e6")
board |>
  dplyr::mutate(layers = vapply(layers, paste, "", collapse = ", "),
                species = vapply(species, paste, "", collapse = ", "),
                depends_on = vapply(depends_on, function(x) if (length(x)) paste(x, collapse = ", ") else "", ""),
                report = ifelse(file.exists(file.path(root, "hypotheses", dir, "RESULT.md")),
                                sprintf("[Result & caveats](results/%s.html)", dir),
                                sprintf("[Registration](https://github.com/urol-e5/MOSAiC-hypotheses/blob/main/hypotheses/%s/hypothesis.md)", dir)),
                title = ifelse(id == "H02",
                               paste0(title, "<br><small><strong>Interpretation:</strong> Acropora is much more seasonally plastic; the Pocillopora–Porites ordering is weak and does not establish a robust three-species ranking.</small>"),
                               title)) |>
  dplyr::select(id, tier, title, status, layers, species, depends_on, report) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "Hypotheses") |>
  cols_label(id = "ID", tier = "Tier", title = "Claim", status = "Status",
             layers = "Layers", species = "Species", depends_on = "Depends on", report = "Details") |>
  fmt_markdown(columns = c(title, report)) |>
  cols_width(id ~ px(45), tier ~ px(35), title ~ pct(35), status ~ px(100)) |>
  data_color(columns = status, fn = function(x) unname(status_colors[x])) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(13))
```

## Tiers

1. **Variance structure.** Colony vs season vs site. Everything downstream depends on these.
2. **Regulatory layers.** Methylation, miRNA, lncRNA.
3. **Phenotype and environment.** Physiology, symbionts, thermal history, nutrients.
4. **Integration.** Multi-omics factors and energetics.
